author: Nekosuki

prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage monument line plate. The documentary photograph(s) show the ACTUAL extant building; use them for architecture and geometry. The LAST image is ONLY the project's fine black ink line style sample, never a building-shape reference. Kasuga Taisha's FOUR extant 1863 main sanctuaries (honden) in Nara. Images 1 and 2 show actual four small red Kasuga-zukuri honden aligned in a STEPPED row along a slope, partially occluded by trees and enclosure; use the true architectural forms and arrangement but omit trees, enclosure, gate and other structures to reveal the four halls. Each hall is one-bay, red and white, cypress-bark gabled roof with frontal canopy and forked chigi. Render exactly four separate compact sanctuaries in one descending diagonal row, not the large middle gate or corridor. Landscape composition. Omit people, trees, sky, signs and surrounding scenery. Fine neutral BLACK architectural contours, sparse internal detail, no large shaded masses. Keep the complete subject centered with generous margin. Perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas inside and outside openings. No shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, gray wash, crosshatching, checkerboard, transparency, text, labels, frame or watermark.
